sols.definition:
plural of Sol
n. a colloid that has a continuous liquid phase in which a solid is suspended in a liquid
n. (Roman mythology) ancient Roman god; personification of the sun; counterpart of Greek Helios
n. the syllable naming the fifth (dominant) note of any musical scale in solmization
sols.translation:
(Sol 的复数) n. 溶胶, 索尔(秘鲁货币单位)
[化] 溶胶

solstice.definition: n. either of the two times of the year when the sun is at its greatest distance from the celestial equator
solstice.translation: n. 至, 至日, 至点, 极限, 决定性时刻

solstices.definition: n. either of the two times of the year when the sun is at its greatest distance from the celestial equator
solstices.translation: n. 至, 至日, 至点( solstice的复数形式 )

solstitial.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a solstice.
a. Happening at a solstice; esp. (with reference to the
   northern hemisphere), happening at the summer solstice, or midsummer.
solstitial.translation: a. 至的, 冬至的, 夏至的
